title: Sardine Chowder
description: A hearty and flavorful soup made with sardines, potatoes, and cream.
instructions: Heat butter in a large pot over medium heat.
Add diced potatoes and cook until they start to soften.
Add light chowder mix and stir to combine.
Add canned sardines, breaking them up with a spoon as they heat.
Pour in milk and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and let cook for 10-15 minutes, or until the soup has thickened.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
